method: The original ggml_quantize_chunk wrote both operands. Reference MUL_MAT used F16 weights and BF16 activations. MUL_MAT_ID used BF16 weights, BF16 activations and expert IDs 1 and 0. The two activation columns include +131072 and -131072. Both run on the pinned single-threaded GGML CPU.
comparison: Widths 8 and 66 use fractional operands and the pinned test_mul_mat and test_mul_mat_id NMSE limit. Widths 16 and 68 use integers with exactly representable products and partial sums, requiring bit identity. Both groups include finite BF16 activations outside F16 range.
